meta.description: Claims one Arena review job, grades only the sources that job returned, then closes that same lease. Contract: docs/backend/N8N_GRADING_WORKFLOW.md. Never posts a final score - the backend computes it.
meta.arenaOwns: reviews-run queue (claim/lease). The scheduler workflow must NOT also schedule reviews-run.

nodes.name: Got a job?
nodes.notes: QUEUE_EMPTY is a 200 with job: null. Stop quietly - do not retry.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.AI_REVIEW_MODEL, temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }] }) }}

nodes.name: Grade with model
nodes.notes: Must finish well inside the 600s lease.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jobId: $json.jobId ?? $('Build blind prompt').first().json.jobId, workerId: 'n8n-grading', code: $json.code ?? 'MODEL_CALL_FAILED', message: ($json.message ?? 'model call failed').toString().slice(0, 500) }) }}

nodes.name: Report the failure
nodes.notes: Reporting keeps the reason; a silently expired lease recovers without one. A technical failure never spends a participant review attempt.
